title: Distilling the Shape of Uncertainty: What On-Policy Distillation Learns and How to Predict It
abstract: arXiv:2610.39020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly adopted in the post-training of large language models. However, a stronger teacher may fail to improve the student. Prior work attributes this to a lack of new knowledge, but what that knowledge is remains unclear. We show that OPD learns not only \textit{how to branch}, i.e., which candidate tokens to consider, but also \textit{where to branch}, i.e., where to keep reasoning paths open. The existing token-overlap metric captures only the former. We introduce the entropy shape, the sequence of next-token entropies, to characterize the latter, and propose the Entropy Shape Correlation (ESC) to measure student-teacher agreement in entropy shape. Tracking ESC throughout training and intervening on a teacher's entropy while preserving its token preferences, we empirically show that \textit{where to branch} causally drives OPD gains, independently of \textit{how to branch}. translated_title: 蒸馏不确定性的形状：在线策略蒸馏学到了什么以及如何预测它
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏在大语言模型的后训练中正被越来越广泛地采用。然而，更强的教师模型可能无法提升学生模型的表现。先前的工作将此归因于缺乏新知识，但这些知识究竟是什么仍不明确。我们证明，OPD不仅学习“如何分支”，即考虑哪些候选token，还学习“在哪里分支”，即在何处保持推理路径的开放。现有的token重叠度量只能捕捉前者。我们引入“熵形状”，即下一个token熵的序列，来刻画后者，并提出熵形状相关性这一指标来衡量学生与教师在熵形状上的一致程度。通过在整个训练过程中追踪ESC，并在保持教师token偏好的同时干预其熵值，我们实证表明“在哪里分支”会因果地驱动OPD的收益，且独立于“如何分支”。最后，我们提出了……
tldr: 该论文发现在线策略蒸馏的关键在于学习“在哪里分支”（保持推理路径开放）而非仅仅是“如何分支”（选择候选token），并提出熵形状相关性（ESC）指标来预测蒸馏收益。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that on-policy distillation gains are causally driven by learning "where to branch" (keeping reasoning paths open) rather than just "how to branch" (token selection), and proposes Entropy Shape Correlation (ESC) as a metric to predict distillation outcomes.
